tenderSchedule.title: PC-1520 Manufacture and supply of Weasel ACSR conductor as per GESCOM specifications for Ballari Zone
tenderSchedule.description: PC-1520 Manufacture and supply of Weasel ACSR conductor as per GESCOM specifications for Ballari Zone
tenderSchedule.locationName: GESCOM Superintending Engineer Procurement Corporate Office Gulbarga

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

If the bidder has participated in more than one bid, the bidder shall fulfill the conditions in QR at clause (3), (4), (8) and (9) for Work done, Performance, annual turnover and Liquid assets cumulatively for all tender enquiries participated respectively. If this condition is not met, then the offer of the bidder will be considered for the tender enquiry for which the bidder is eligible at the discretion of GESCOM.Acceptance in this regard shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Average Annual Financial Turnover of the Bidder should not be less than 50% of the Amount Put to Tender during the preceding 2 financial years. (I.e. FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26.)The audited balance sheets (including profit and loss account sheet) signed by CAs with UDIN and signed by the authorized signatory of the firm for each of the financial year (i.e., 2024-25 and 2025-26) shall be scanned and uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Liquid assets as on the date of previous month of tender inviting date or at a later date before submission of the bid consisting of Cash at Bank Plus Term Deposit in any Nationalized or Scheduled Bank on or after the date of notification of tender Plus Availability of credit facility in an Nationalized or Scheduled Bank shall not be less than 12.5 % of the amount put to tender, which shall be supported by certificate issued by any Nationalized or Scheduled Bank. The cash at bank, term deposits and availability of fund based credit facilities shall be supported by a certificate issued by Nationalized or scheduled Bank shall be uploaded in the sample format Annexure-B. If the Tenderer has banking with more than one Bank, then the available liquid assets mentioned above on a particular date i.e., as on last date of previous month of tender inviting date or any date before submission of tender shall be the same date for all the banks. In case of Fund based credit facility, the certificate issued by the Nationalized or Scheduled Bank duly mentioning sanctioned limits, funds utilized so far and balance available as on last date of previous month of tender inviting date or at a later date, before submission of the bid shall be uploaded.

The Bidder shall be individual Proprietorship firm or partnership firm or Company Registered under Companies Act 1956/2013. Note: Weasel ACSR Conductor tenders to be invited from MSEs only and Bidder should have been registered with the Director of Industries & Commerce, Govt. of Karnataka as a Micro & Small Enterprises (MSE) under Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006 (Central Act 27 of 2006) for Manufacture of ACSR Conductor.Registration certificate/SSI Certificate/UDAYM certificate (MSME)/license issued by the Commerce & Industries department or any other Government statutory Authority shall be uploaded.For Proprietorship firm, PAN and GST registration certificate shall be uploaded in original. The bidder shall also upload valid registration certificate issued by the Director of Industries & Commerce, Govt. of Karnataka as a Micro & Small Enterprises (MSE) for Manufacturer of ACSR Conductor shall be uploaded in original.

The Bidder shall be Manufacturer of ACSR Conductor specified in the tender and shall have a minimum experience of 3 years in manufacturing, testing and supply of material of same or higher type specified in the tender as on the date of bid submission.The Bidder shall scan and upload Purchase order/Order Completion certificates/performance certificates clearly mentioning experience of minimum 3 years as Manufacturer of material of the same or higher type specified in the tender, shall be uploaded in original.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Purchase order/Order Completion certificates/performance certificates

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have manufactured and supplied at least 40 Percentage of the tendered quantity of Weasel ACSR conductor or higher type specified in the tender in any one of the preceding 3 Financial years (i.e 2023-2024,2024-2025 and 2025-2026) to ESCOMs/Distribution companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/PSUs.The Bidder shall scan and upload Order completion certificates issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent officer of the concerned ESCOMs/ Distribution Companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/ PSUs.

The Bidder shall upload performance certificate for satisfactory operation of at least 40% of required quantity of Weasel ACSR conductor or higher type specified in the tender for a period of at least one year in any one of the preceding 3 Financial years (i.e 2023-2024,2024-2025 and 2025-2026) from ESCOMs/ Distribution companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/ PSUs.The Bidder shall scan and upload the performance certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent officer of the concerned ESCOMs/ Distribution Companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/ PSUs.

The bidder should have valid Bureau of Indian Standard Certification during the preceding 3 years. BIS certificates issued by the Govt. of India should be valid since from past 3 years from the date of publishing the tender.The Bidder shall scan and upload BIS certificate in original.
The Bidder shall upload GTPs, failing which the bid document is liable for rejection.The Bidder shall scan and upload GTP as per IS.

The Bidder shall upload the type test certificates for having conducted all the type tests mentioned in the relevant IS/technical specification on the Weasel ACSR conductor at any NABL accredited labs/CPRI/ERDA & such type test reports shall not be older than Seven years as on the last date of bid submission. The type test reports from other than any NABL accredited labs /CPRI/ERDA shall not be considered and such bids will be treated as Non-Responsive. Valid type test certificates from NABL accredited labs/CPRI/ERDA centers shall be uploaded

The Bidder should not have been DEFAULTED in supplies against Purchase Orders placed by any ESCOMs/Distribution companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/PSUs.Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- by the Bidder adhering to this clause shall be uploaded.
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: Self Declaration for not have been defaulted

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self Declaration for not have been defaulted

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should not be under order of debarment/Blacklisting from participating in a Tender by any ESCOMs/Distribution companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/ PSUs, as on the last date of submission of bids. Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100 by the Bidder adhering to this clause shall be uploaded.

Litigation History: The Bidder should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years, A consistent history of awards involving litigation against the Bidder or any partner may result in rejection of Bid.Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.

Any Bidder/Bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Bidder is registered with the Competent Authority. A certificate for having read the clauses specified in Section-XVI of the tender documents under the heading Eligibility clauses in respect of restrictions on procurement from a Bidder/Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India shall be uploaded by the Bidder/Bidder in the following format: i) I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Bidder/Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India I certify that this Bidder/Bidder is not from such a country or, if from such a country, has been registered with the Competent Authority. I hereby certify that this Bidder/Bidder fulfills all requirements in this regard and is eligible to be considered. (Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by the Competent Authority shall be attached/ uploaded.) ii) I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Bidder/vendor having Transfer of Technology (ToT) arrangement. I certify that this Bidder/vendor does not have any ToT arrangement requiring registration with the competent authority. OR I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Bidder/Bidder/vendor having Transfer of Technology (ToT) arrangement. I certify that this Bidder/Bidder/ vendor has valid registration to participate in this procurement. Registration certificate issued by the competent authority shall be uploaded. Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100 in the prescribed format shall be uploaded.
